exposure: Specific LQTS rhythms (Functional 2deg atrioventricular block, T-wave alternans, torsade de pointes)
Novel fetal rhythms (atrioventricular block with 3:1 conduction ratio, QRS alternans in 2:1 atrioventricular block, long-cycle length TdP, slow monomorphic ventricular tachycardia)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 39 fetuses identified from a fetal magnetocardiography database, all confirmed to have pathogenic variants in LQTS genes.
finding: De novo LQTS variants, particularly de novo SCN5A variants, were strongly associated with a severe rhythm phenotype and perinatal death, including stillbirth and death in infancy, often presenting with complex and novel fetal arrhythmias.
followup_time: Outcomes included stillbirth and death in infancy, indicating observation up to one year post-birth for live-born infants.
